promises.quote: An additional sign will be erected at the top of the steps (adjacent to the south east slip) which leads to the 'underpass'. This will indicate the presence of a pedestrian route (via steps) and identify the pedestrian destination. Investigative work will be undertaken to confirm that the pedestrian route is appropriately signed on both sides of the bridgehead.
promises.summary: Erect sign indicating pedestrian route and destination within three months
promises.timescale: three months from the date of this letter
